title: stomatacon
intro: The ’Stomatacon’ component calculates the stomata conductance of water vapour.

sections.name: WSF

attrs.name: beta
attrs.doc:
Effect of ABA concentration. The effect is exp (-beta (—ABA— - ABA min)),
     where —ABA— is the ABA concentration in the xylem.

attrs.name: ABA min
attrs.doc: Level of ABA with unstressed production.

attrs.name: delta
attrs.doc:
Effect of crown water potential. The effect is exp (-delta —psi c—), where
     psi c is the crown potential.

sections.text:
Common water stress effect parameters.
  < WSF (beta 0 [cm3 /g])
        (ABA min 0 [g/cm3 ])
        (delta 0 [MPa−1 ]) >

    beta: number [cm3 /g]
     Parameter (default 0)
     Effect of ABA concentration. The effect is exp (-beta (—ABA— - ABA min)),
     where —ABA— is the ABA concentration in the xylem.

    ABA min: number [g/cm3 ]
     Parameter (default 0)
     Level of ABA with unstressed production.

    delta: number [MPa−1 ]
     Parameter (default 0)
     Effect of crown water potential. The effect is exp (-delta —psi c—), where
     psi c is the crown potential.
